name: Google Forms
title: workspace.google.com
shortDescription: Google Forms allows users to quickly create and distribute forms and surveys to gather data and insights on-the-go. Suitable for businesses of all sizes, it offers customizable templates and real-time analytics. Users can share forms via email, social media, or embed them on websites, making it ideal for collecting feedback, conducting research, or testing knowledge with quizzes.
cons: Basic design options compared to specialized tools
Potential privacy concerns for sensitive data
